steps.title: In the ground

form.name: Lanthanum in bastnäsite
form.label: about a third of the rare earths

steps.text: The seventeen rare earths always occur together, never alone. The light ones, lanthanum among them, come mainly from bastnäsite, mined in hard rock at Bayan Obo in China and Mountain Pass in California, and from monazite, a heavy grain in beach sands. Lanthanum is the second most plentiful of them.
steps.india: Monazite in the beach sands of Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh. It is rich in the light rare earths and poor in the heavy ones.

steps.title: Mine
steps.text: Bastnäsite is mined from open pits, crushed and floated to a concentrate of about 60% rare-earth oxide. Monazite is sorted out of dredged beach sand with magnets and electrostatic plates, alongside ilmenite and zircon.
steps.india: 2,900 tonnes of rare-earth oxide in 2025, 0.7% of the world, all from monazite in beach sands worked by IREL.

steps.title: Crack
steps.text: The concentrate is broken down with hot acid or caustic soda so the rare earths dissolve. Monazite also releases thorium and a little uranium, which are radioactive and must be removed and stored. What is left is a mixed rare-earth chloride or carbonate: all the elements still together.

steps.title: Separate
steps.text: This is the hard part. Neighbouring rare earths behave almost identically, so the solution is run through hundreds of solvent-extraction stages, each shifting the balance slightly, until lanthanum comes out on its own as an oxide. China does about 91% of the world's separation.
steps.india: IREL makes commercial-grade lanthanum oxide from monazite at Aluva and at OSCOM in Odisha, a small volume against demand.

steps.title: Make
steps.text: Lanthanum oxide and chloride are blended into the zeolite catalysts that oil refineries use to crack heavy oil into petrol. The metal is alloyed with nickel for the negative electrode of nickel-metal-hydride batteries.

steps.title: Use
steps.text: Refinery cracking catalysts are the largest use. Lanthanum glass bends light strongly and goes into camera and microscope lenses. Hybrid cars with nickel-metal-hydride batteries carry several kilograms.

steps.title: Recycle
steps.text: Very little is recovered from old products: each one holds grams, spread thin and hard to collect. Scrap from the factories that make these materials is the main source.
